tasks.label: dotnet: format current file
args: $file=$env:VSCODE_DOTNET_FORMAT_FILE; $start=Split-Path -Parent $file; $dir=$start; $sln=$null; while ($dir) { $sln=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter *.sln -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($sln) { break }; $parent=Split-Path -Parent $dir; if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $dir) { break }; $dir=$parent }; if (-not $sln) { Write-Error ('No .sln found upward from: ' + $start); exit 1 }; Push-Location -LiteralPath $sln.Directory.FullName; $rel=(Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $file -Relative).ToString().Replace('\','/'); Write-Host ('dotnet format file: ' + $rel); & dotnet format $sln.FullName --include $rel --verbosity minimal; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Pop-Location; exit $code

tasks.label: dotnet: format solution
args: $file=$env:VSCODE_DOTNET_FORMAT_FILE; $start=Split-Path -Parent $file; $dir=$start; $sln=$null; while ($dir) { $sln=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter *.sln -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($sln) { break }; $parent=Split-Path -Parent $dir; if (-not $parent -or $parent -eq $dir) { break }; $dir=$parent }; if (-not $sln) { Write-Error ('No .sln found upward from: ' + $start); exit 1 }; Push-Location -LiteralPath $sln.Directory.FullName; Write-Host ('dotnet format solution: ' + $sln.FullName); & dotnet format $sln.FullName --verbosity minimal; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Pop-Location; exit $code
